design.authorization: 2026-10-27 사용자: 실험 a를 진행하고 보고서까지 작성; 클래스당 2/5/10/20, 무작위·고유벡터·다양성 선택과 커버리지 비교

reference.unit: uniform random rows from clean original train; remove these IDs from every selection/scaler/cluster pool; same-vector rows may remain and zero-distance rate is reported

geometry.numeric: signed log1p, candidate-only median and IQR (floor 0.1), clip standardized values to [-6,6]
geometry.scaler_fit: fixed uniform maximum 5000 candidate rows per class, equally weighted classes
geometry.categorical_distance: one-hot/sqrt(2): one categorical mismatch contributes one squared-distance unit; vocabulary from candidate rows only, separate unknown category
geometry.distance: Euclidean distance divided by sqrt(46); per-class reference distance only; geometry is diagnostic, model input remains original 46 features
geometry.clustering: KMeans Lloyd, fixed class/k-specific seed, n_init=3, max_iter=300; at most 100000 uniformly sampled candidate rows per class for fitting, deduplicated transformed vectors with exact frequency sample weights; representatives are closest actual candidate in each cluster, searched over the full pool; require exactly k occupied clusters
geometry.selection: seeded first representative then greedy farthest-first among cluster representatives; nested prefixes 2/5/10/20; cluster40 checks arbitrary granularity
geometry.patterns: clusters and distance are operational feature-space measures, not verified attack-pattern labels

design.preparation_revision: Initial MiniBatchKMeans preparation stopped before any model fits: CIC bot had 19 occupied groups at k=20. Frequency-weighted unique-geometry Lloyd KMeans replaces the minibatch approximation; failed run and source snapshot are retained.
design.models: unchanged EXP87 XGB300/depth8 and frozen TabPFN-v3/4 estimators; no tuning or fine-tuning
design.evaluation: same full fixed attack-only test and mixed query order as EXP87, batch8192; five paired seeds; no benign training or inference
design.checks: train/reference/test ID disjointness; original clean train membership; equal per-class budgets; nested contexts; same rows and features between models; independent sklearn metric recalculation; frozen checkpoint digest
design.interpretation: Selection knows full candidate-class labels and features: representativeness diagnosis, not an acquisition algorithm using only n labels. Existing test already inspected. Conditional on global conflict cleaning and within-collection split; no environment-bias conclusion.
design.report: Korean standalone LaTeX, learning curves, per-class F1, coverage/unique vectors, paired gaps, costs, raw predictions and code snapshots; temporary PDF compilation; no manuscript/slides changes
